summary: Iteration 12 verification for AdminKit. Backend pytest: 59/60 pass (added 8 new tests in TestIteration12EmptyPersists + TestIteration12AuditTrailFeatures). The BUG-FIX for empty-string persistence is VERIFIED WORKING at API level for all four appearance fields (brand_initials, tagline, meta_title, meta_keywords, footer_text) AND for storage (s3_path, s3_public_url) — PUT '' then GET returns '' (no fallback to defaults). Audit Trail features verified: /audit-trail route + AuditTrail component, /activity route returns 404, sidebar renames to 'Audit Trail' (no 'Log Aktivitas'), row-detail dialog with sections activity-detail-changes / activity-detail-context / activity-detail-technical / activity-detail-close, dialog has max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto (thin-scroll) — scrollable ✓, purge past-range 2020-01-01..02 returns 302 (no 500), user-update produces name diff (old/new both present + method=PUT + url), user password change is masked as '••••••' (no bcrypt hash / plaintext leaks in JSON blob), failed-login (bad password) recorded as level=danger action='Percobaan masuk gagal' with status_code=422 and context containing 'kredensial: zulfame'. Frontend UI verified: sidebar rename, dialog testids, technical section contents (Alamat IP, Metode, URL, Kode Status, User Agent, ID Log), appearance/storage form testids all present. CRITICAL DEFECT FOUND: 403 access-denied responses are NOT recorded in Audit Trail — verified by logging in as a fresh Staf user, hitting /appearance which returned 403 (correct authz), but no audit row with status_code=403 appears. Root cause: bootstrap/app.php uses $exceptions->report() callback, but Laravel's default reportable-exception filter (HttpException, AuthorizationException, UnauthorizedException are in the ignored list) prevents the callback from ever firing on 403s. Fix: call $exceptions->stopIgnoring(HttpException::class) and $exceptions->stopIgnoring(AuthorizationException::class) / UnauthorizedException::class, or move the recording into a render() callback that runs unconditionally.

critical.issue: 403 access-denied (AuthorizationException / Spatie UnauthorizedException / HttpException 403) is NEVER logged to Audit Trail because Laravel ignores these classes for reporting by default. Test 'test_forbidden_403_recorded' fails: real Staf user hits /appearance → 403 returned but no audit row with status_code=403 exists. Fix: add $exceptions->stopIgnoring([\Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException::class, \Spatie\Permission\Exceptions\UnauthorizedException::class, \Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException::class]); or use a render() callback that records BEFORE Laravel renders.

rca_of_the_issue: Symptom: 403 access-denied never appears in Audit Trail. Reproduction: log in as a role without 'appearance.view' (e.g. Staf), GET /appearance → 403 returned; then check /audit-trail — no danger row with status_code=403. Root cause: /app/adminkit/bootstrap/app.php registers a $exceptions->report(function($e) {...}) callback that inspects the exception class and calls ActivityLog::record for 403/500. However Laravel's ExceptionHandler filters exceptions through dontReport()/isFatal() BEFORE invoking reportable callbacks; HttpException (all 4xx), AuthorizationException, and Spatie's UnauthorizedException are all ignored by default, so the callback never runs for 403. Fix: either (a) add $exceptions->stopIgnoring([HttpException::class, AuthorizationException::class, UnauthorizedException::class]); inside withExceptions(), OR (b) migrate the audit-recording to a $exceptions->render(function($e, $req){ ActivityLog::record(...); return null; }) callback so it fires irrespective of reporting rules.
